clue.text: Again eating mushroom to build up muscle

indicators.note: one piece eating another means it takes the other inside itself

parts.note: bis is a musical direction meaning repeat, again
the cep is an edible mushroom, the porcini

explanation.surface: A bodybuilder tucks into mushrooms yet again to bulk up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eating' puts the mushroom inside the musical word for again; 'to build up' is linking surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The biceps is the large flexor in the upper arm, the classic bodybuilder's showpiece.

clue.text: Tall thin supporter of runners

definitions.meaning: a stick up which runner beans climb

explanation.surface: A lanky fan of athletes.
explanation.definitionFit: A gangling person is likened to the tall stake supporting climbing beans.

clue.text: Pet about to whimper in plagued house

indicators.note: the pet goes about the whimper, surrounding it

parts.note: a cat is a pet
to pule is to whine or whimper

explanation.surface: The family pet whines in a stricken household.
explanation.walkthrough: Mercutio cries 'A plague o' both your houses!' at the Montagues and this family in Romeo and Juliet.
explanation.definitionFit: Juliet's family is one of the two houses cursed by Mercutio.

clue.text: Praying with Church of England, composed words of praise

indicators.note: composed means put together anew, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Anglican prayers set down in a hymn of praise.
explanation.definitionFit: A eulogy or speech of high praise is a formal tribute.

clue.text: Old embassy's oversight

parts.note: a mission is a diplomatic embassy abroad

explanation.surface: An embassy of old made a blunder.
explanation.definitionFit: Something left out by mistake is an oversight, a failure to include.

clue.text: United rivals developing synthetic cream

indicators.note: developing suggests the letters are worked into a new form

explanation.surface: A lab developing a synthetic cream.
explanation.walkthrough: United are Manchester United, whose great local rivals are the other Manchester football club.
explanation.definitionFit: The other football club in Manchester is United's derby opponent.

clue.text: Left suddenly broke into factions

definitions.meaning: slang for departed in a hurry

explanation.surface: The left wing suddenly fractured into rival camps.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses share one slang verb: departing fast and dividing in two.

clue.text: One new computer unit beneficially provides desktop writing aid

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
K, kilobyte, is a unit of computer memory
well means to good effect, beneficially

explanation.surface: A new computer gadget brings a writing aid to the desktop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'desktop' looks like computing, but means the top of an old school desk.
explanation.definitionFit: An ink pot set into a desk top held ink for dip pens.

clue.text: Lack of medication for swelling

definitions.meaning: read as two words, no medicine dose given

explanation.surface: No treatment was given for the swelling.
explanation.definitionFit: In botany and medicine the word describes something knotted with nodes, swollen lumps.

clue.text: Hard lines?

parts.note: hard lines sounds like bad luck, but read as lines of verse that are solid, like a building material

explanation.surface: Bad luck!
explanation.definitionFit: Verse whose typographic layout forms a picture is named after a solid building material.

clue.text: Instrument for off-peak calls

parts.note: off-peak looks like cheap-rate telephoning, but means calls sounded out from the Alpine peaks on a long wooden horn

explanation.surface: Some gadget for making cheap-rate phone calls.
explanation.definitionFit: This long wooden horn was used by herdsmen to send calls across Swiss mountain valleys.

clue.text: Popular song about king

indicators.note: the song goes about the king, surrounding his letter

parts.note: a lied is a German art song
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A well-loved song about a monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Popular means well thought of, held in favour by people.

clue.text: Wind's backing visible in photograph of open sea

indicators.note: seen inside the photograph, so placed within it

parts.note: pic is short for picture, a photograph

indicators.note: backing means the word for wind is read from back to front

parts.note: a gale is a strong wind

explanation.surface: A snapshot of the open sea shows the wind veering round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' reverses the wind before 'visible in' places it inside the photograph; pelagic is a word from marine biology.
explanation.definitionFit: Pelagic describes the open ocean, away from coasts and the seabed.

clue.text: Without cover from air, thus exposed on Yorkshire moor

definitions.meaning: having no covering for the head

definitions.text: from air, thus exposed on Yorkshire moor
definitions.meaning: the folk song On Ilkla Moor Baht 'at tells of a man out on the Yorkshire moor without a hat

explanation.surface: Bare to the elements on a moor, as an old tune has it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On Ilkla Moor Baht 'at' is a Yorkshire dialect folk song (an air) about going onto Ilkley Moor without a hat.
explanation.definitionFit: Going without a hat leaves the head uncovered.

clue.text: See new driver tear off further down the road

parts.note: L is the learner plate, marking a new driver in Britain

indicators.note: tear off suggests the letters of tear go off course, rearranged

explanation.surface: Watch the learner driver tear off down the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' rearranges the letters of tear; the L-plate is the British learner driver's sign. 'See' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Something further down the road comes afterwards, in the future.

clue.text: Get wind of Daisy in cathedral city

indicators.note: the flower sits inside the city's name

parts.note: Ely is a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire
the aster is a daisy-like flower

explanation.surface: Hearing of a woman called Daisy who lives in Ely.
explanation.definitionFit: An east wind, blowing from the east, is a named wind.

clue.text: English horse second to American named after famous person

parts.note: a pony is a small horse
mo is a brief moment
US means American

explanation.surface: An English horse comes second to an American one.
explanation.definitionFit: The word describes a person after whom something is named, or the thing so named.

clue.text: Translate English or Latin into Chinese, for example

indicators.note: translate means turn into another form, rearranging the letters

explanation.surface: An instruction to put English or Latin into Chinese.
explanation.definitionFit: Chinese people and culture are an example of the Eastern, Far East.

clue.text: Feature of Susan's mouse

definitions.meaning: the ... Susan is a flower with a dark centre
mouse is slang for a bruised, swollen eye

explanation.surface: Something characteristic of Susan's pet mouse.
explanation.definitionFit: A bruised eye after a punch is called a mouse in slang, and Black-eyed Susan's eye is dark.

clue.text: Pull fish up on one side of boat

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the pieces read from bottom to top

parts.note: to draw is to pull
an eel is a fish

explanation.surface: Hauling a fish up over the side of a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: The sheltered side, away from the wind, is one side of a vessel.

clue.text: Come about small volume in our keeping

indicators.note: our keeping it means our word holds the volume inside

parts.note: cc, cubic centimetre, is a small measure of volume

explanation.surface: A slim book comes into our possession.
explanation.definitionFit: To happen or take place is to come about.

clue.text: Tip given in a wine bar

parts.note: cant means tilt or tip

explanation.surface: Leaving a gratuity in a wine bar.
explanation.definitionFit: A cantina is a Spanish or Latin American bar serving wine.

clue.text: Balance plates of fish

definitions.meaning: the small overlapping plates on a fish's skin

explanation.surface: Fish dishes balanced on plates.
explanation.definitionFit: A weighing device and fish skin plates share one plural word.

clue.text: Expression used by drinkers for so long

definitions.meaning: a cheery toast said when raising glasses

explanation.surface: What drinkers say for a long time.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a British informal farewell, and also used as a toast.

clue.text: Frenchman and wife to make a fresh start

parts.note: Rene is a French man's name

explanation.surface: A Frenchman and his wife begin again.
explanation.definitionFit: To begin again on something is to restore or resume it.

clue.text: Red-hot stuff from South American capital

definitions.meaning: a fiery red chilli pepper powder

explanation.surface: Something fiery from a South American capital.
explanation.definitionFit: A hot red pepper spice shares its name with the capital of French Guiana.

clue.text: Master using king to take knight

parts.note: Lear is Shakespeare's tragic king
N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: A chess game where the king takes a knight.
explanation.definitionFit: To master a skill is to acquire it fully by study.

clue.text: He impresses with his colourful technique

definitions.text: He impresses with his colourful technique

parts.words: He impresses with his colourful technique
parts.note: impresses literally, marking skin with inked designs, rather than winning admiration

explanation.surface: An artist who dazzles with flamboyant skill.
explanation.definitionFit: A body artist presses coloured ink into skin with needles.

clue.text: With spin on ball, approaches obliquely

parts.note: side is the spin given to a billiard ball
ways are methods, approaches

explanation.surface: A bowler puts spin on the ball and comes in at an angle.
explanation.walkthrough: In billiards and snooker, SIDE is spin imparted by striking the ball off-centre.
explanation.definitionFit: Moving at a slant rather than straight on is moving at an angle.

clue.text: Vehemently criticise very musical line

parts.note: assai is the musical term for very

explanation.surface: Lambast a line that is excessively musical.
explanation.definitionFit: To attack verbally and with force is to lay into someone.
